scope: Synthetic API and typed-result acceptance only; not actual media scoring or creative acceptance
offline_requirements: block secret-like input, media URLs and local paths
fixed model and destination with no redirect or ambient proxy
single writer and explicit limited concurrency
bounded 429 retry; never resend an uncertain request
resume completed items without new paid requests
reject changed manifest and modified cached response
validate typed answers, provider, exact model, probabilities and cost
preserve original response and observed usage without invented interpretation
private output permissions and no credentials in artifacts
live_test_policy: Optional and billable. Freeze these expectations before a live run; do not run in CI. Public translated examples have not been live-tested.
